summary_1line: Sukra counsels Devayani on mastering anger; when she refuses forgiveness for insult, he confronts King Vrishaparvan and threatens to abandon the Asuras unless she is appeased.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sukra stands before the Asura king Vrishaparvan in a royal hall, sternly declaring he will abandon the Asuras while courtiers watch in alarm.
Sukra gently instructs Devayani as she stands rigid with anger, the sage raising a hand while speaking of conquering wrath.
A symbolic image of a snake casting off its old skin beside a calm sage, illustrating Sukra’s teaching about shedding anger.
